title: 💸 The way you spend money may reveal more about your faith than your Sunday attendance.
paragraphs: 💸 The way you spend money may reveal more about your faith than your Sunday attendance.
That stings.
But it's true.
Many Christians pray for financial breakthrough...
Yet never ask whether their finances actually honor God.
We want God to bless our money.
But do we manage it His way?
We stress over bills.
We chase more income.
We compare ourselves to others.
We buy things we don't need.
And then wonder why we feel trapped.
The real issue isn't always the amount of money you have.
The real issue is stewardship.
How to Honor God With Your Finances
This powerful biblical guide will help you stop viewing money through the world's lens and start managing it through God's wisdom.
Because money is never just about money.
It's about trust.
It's about priorities.
It's about worship.
It's about who sits on the throne of your heart.
✅ How to put God first in every financial decision
✅ Biblical principles of stewardship that actually work
✅ The hidden danger of financial idolatry
✅ How to break free from destructive money habits
✅ The power of generosity and kingdom impact
✅ How contentment creates true financial peace
✅ What Scripture teaches about debt, saving, giving, and wealth
✅ How to use your finances for eternal purposes
⚔️ MOST PEOPLE vs FEW PEOPLE
Most people ask:
"How can I make more money?"
Few people ask:
"How can I honor God with what I already have?"
Most people chase possessions.
Few people pursue stewardship.
Most people want God's blessings.
Few people want God's wisdom.
Most people build temporary wealth.
Few people build eternal treasure.
Which group are you in?
